gaps.sentence: We sat ___ to the sound of the waves.
gaps.explanation: 'Listen to' means to pay attention to sound deliberately; after 'sat' the -ing form is needed.

gaps.sentence: Please ___ me to post this letter.
gaps.hint: make somebody not forget: ___ somebody to do something
gaps.explanation: 'Remind somebody to do something' means to make someone remember; 'remember' is something you do yourself.

gaps.sentence: There is little ___ that the plan will be approved.
gaps.hint: pattern: little ___ that something will happen
gaps.explanation: 'Possibility that ...' is the standard pattern; 'opportunity' means a situation that lets you do something.
'Especially' means in particular or above all; 'specially' means for one particular purpose.

gaps.sentence: The children left ___ toys all over the floor.
gaps.explanation: 'Their' shows possession; 'there' is a place; 'they're' means 'they are'; 'theirs' is a possessive pronoun standing alone.

gaps.sentence: Her annual ___ is reviewed every April.
gaps.hint: fixed regular pay for professional work, usually monthly
gaps.explanation: 'Salary' is fixed regular pay for professional or office work, usually paid monthly; 'wages' are usually weekly.

gaps.sentence: You ___ a lot of water by having such long showers.
gaps.hint: to use something valuable without needing to
gaps.explanation: 'Waste' means to use more than necessary; 'save' means the opposite — to avoid using.

gaps.sentence: This smell ___ me of my childhood.
gaps.explanation: 'Remind somebody of something' means to make someone think of something; 'remember' is not followed by an object + of.
